text:
maria (sec-eng): Heads up — external assessor (AcuitySec) kickoff next Tue 09:30 PT. Need to confirm assessor access matrix, evidence handoff, and KMS/RBAC constraints. who can own?

raj (platform-sec): I can lead assessor access config. quick Q: will they need read-only to production logs or a subset?

maria (sec-eng): Subset only — access to audit logs for app-prod namespace, and S3 evidence bucket. No write, no console actions. Also want to capture any KMS decrypt attempts visibility.

kevin (infra): For S3 we should use pre-signed URLs + short TTL. Prefer zero-console access. I'll prepare an access checklist.

oliver (compliance): Also flag CCPA/PII scopes. If the assessor requests sample data, we should only provide redacted extracts or a synthetic dataset. No raw PII out.

maria (sec-eng): Agreed. Add a requirement: all evidence transfer via our evidence-bucket with server-side encryption + KMS. Need KMS key policy review.

raj (platform-sec): Proposed RBAC: create assessor role binding k8s-read-only + IAM role that maps to sts:AssumeRole for the assessor principal. Policy snippet: 
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["s3:DeleteObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-evidence/*"]}
  ]
}
```
Will add kms:Decrypt denied; only Allow Encrypt/GenerateDataKey for our upload helpers.

kevin (infra): For KMS we need a separate alias for assessor-handshake-key with a key policy that allows only GenerateDataKey but not Decrypt for the assessor role. Example permission set: ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Encrypt"] for assessor IAM principal. Decrypt stays with infra key role.

maria (sec-eng): Perfect. Also we must ensure CloudTrail logs for kms:GenerateDataKey are forwarded to Splunk with an extra retention flag. SOP for review?

sophie (docs): I'll draft the assessor playbook pages: access steps, RBAC snippets, redaction checklist, and evidence upload flow. ETA EOD Fri.

oliver (compliance): Add a compliance checkpoint: confirm retention & deletion policy for assessor-reviewed artifacts (30 days auto-delete). Also record a signed NDA copy in the evidence-bucket metadata.

maria (sec-eng): Good call. Who's owning the retest window and verifying fix evidence later?

kevin (infra): I can own retest verification. Plan: post-remediation, provide a scoped environment snapshot + audit run output. Prefer to run the retest in a staging tenant that mirrors prod tokens but with no PII.

raj (platform-sec): One operational ask: during the assessment, if they trigger a noisy scan we should have rate-limits in place and an automated fallback to a lower-capacity pool. I'll coordinate with runtime team.

scanner-bot: Created ticket SEC-7210 "AcuitySec assessor access & evidence playbook" and assigned to @raj, @sophie, @kevin. Link: https://issues.redwood.dev/SEC-7210

maria (sec-eng): Action items:
- raj: prepare RBAC/IAM policy + test assume-role (due Mon)
- kevin: pre-signed URL workflow + kms alias + automated delete lifecycle (due Mon)
- sophie: docs & redaction checklist (due Fri)
- oliver: NDA + retention confirmation (due Mon)
- kevin: retest verification plan (due after remediation)

Please ping here when you have PRs or runbook URLs. @channel :white_check_mark:
